title: Changing Newsletter folder
summary: When I try to change the folder of my Newsletters, new articles appear again in the Newsletter folder and create a new feed with the same name. For example My_Folder My_Newsletter ← added manually to “My_Folder” Newsletters My_Newsletter ← recreated by NewsBlur after new articles appear. “My_Newsletter” in “My_Folder” stops being updated Is there a way to make Newsletters remember the folder they are in?
body_markdown:
# [Changing Newsletter folder](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/changing-newsletter-folder/13939)


[question](https://forum.newsblur.com/c/question/8)


[SteveBuscemiDress](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/SteveBuscemiDress)


November 16, 2026, 6:31am 1


When I try to change the folder of my Newsletters, new articles appear again in the Newsletter folder and create a new feed with the same name. For example


My_Folder


- My_Newsletter ← added manually to “My_Folder”


Newsletters


- My_Newsletter ← recreated by NewsBlur after new articles appear. “My_Newsletter” in “My_Folder” stops being updated


Is there a way to make Newsletters remember the folder they are in?
